# Penrill

> Penrill is a free infinite whiteboard for pen tablets. It runs in a browser and on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Using Penrill

- [English overview](https://penrill.com/): Features, installation instructions, and frequently asked questions.
- [Ukrainian overview](https://penrill.com/uk/): Features, installation instructions, and frequently asked questions in Ukrainian.
- [Web app](https://app.penrill.com/): Open the whiteboard in a browser.
- [Latest desktop release](https://github.com/Penrill/penrill/releases/latest): Download installers and read release notes.

## Project information

- [App repository](https://github.com/Penrill/penrill): Source code and project documentation.
- [Privacy policy](https://penrill.com/privacy/): Read the policy in English.
- [Ukrainian privacy policy](https://penrill.com/uk/privacy/): Read the policy in Ukrainian.
